discovery_notes: DLR OE 2017 backfill; 28 WebSearch calls, all search_snippet, mostly Disney Pins Blog. Most 2017 OE lines shared DLR/WDW; included only where a snippet named Disneyland. DLR-specific: Sleeping Beauty Castle 2017, Mission Breakout OE (May 2017), emoji sets spotted at DLR first, Princess Gold Frame DLR first, HM Holiday mystery. Many DLR 2017 releases were LE/LR (Pin Trading Tales, Charming Characters, MSEP) - recorded as leads only. No licensed pins found.
